snippet.title: UNIT-5000 - First Teaser
snippet.description:
Meet UNIT-5000 - a singleplayer sci-fi isometric action roguelite where you build your combat mech, survive hostile arenas, and face multi-phase bosses.

This first teaser shows an early look at the game. We are currently working toward the release of the playable demo.

Wishlist UNIT-5000 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3165390/UNIT5000/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=steam_2026_07&utm_content=teaser_01

Join the Emblem Games Discord:
https://discord.gg/pfMzufgvTM

Follow the development:
https://emblem.games/
